main_text.p: [illegible, ~6 letters] extendet, nec pluribus quàm quatuor; ut [illegible, ~4 letters] volvit.

Literæ quæ radicem constituunt, vocantur Radicales : quæ verò ad formationem nominum & verborum accedunt, septem scil. hâc voce inclusæ [illegible, ~7 letters] pinguefient ; vel ad consignificationem, quatuor scil. in hac voce expressæ, [illegible, ~5 letters] in navi, appellantur ser-viles.
main_text.head: SECT. VII.
De Grammaticis & Lexicis Arabicis.
main_text.p: Qui Arabicæ linguæ cognitionem desidè-rat, legat inter alios, (ut Gabrielis Sionitæ & Johannis Efronitæ) maximè Erpenii Rudimenta Arabica, qui omnium accuratissimè Grammaticæ præcepta tradidit : postea verò ipsius Grammaticam Arabicam conferat, ex cujus collatione quædam plenius quàm in Rudimentis explicata inveniet.
Inter Lexica verò, Schindleri Lexicon Pentaglotton, scil. Hebraicum;Chaldaicum, Syriacum, Arabicum & Rabbinicum, ut maximè utile linguarum Orientalium studiosis commendatur.

page.notes: The Arabic words in the first two lines, in the inline "pinguefient" and "in navi" lines, are small Arabic-script words that I could not read letter by letter, so they are marked illegible. The first Arabic word on line one and the Arabic words with the ordinal glosses are the least certain. The Latin text is copied as printed, with long s rendered as plain s. Printed "defide-rat" is kept with its hyphen as printed.
